title: VoxelCore tags.toml
description: Attaches tags to blocks and items of any pack (<pack>/tags.toml): "prefix:tag" = ["pack:block", ...]. Tagging a block also tags its generated item.
markdownDescription: Attaches tags to blocks and items of any pack (`<pack>/tags.toml`): `"prefix:tag" = ["pack:block", ...]`. Tagging a block also tags its generated item.

additionalProperties.description: Block or item ids receiving the tag.
